instruction: Set the 'Fade' transition effect for every slide in the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying Fade transition to all 23 slides. The evaluator reads the PPTX file and checks if all slides have transition effects applied. Custom getter extracts transition information from slide XML, metric verifies all slides have transitions (partial credit for slides with transitions).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: all slides must have transitions AND transition type must be 'fade'
Getter extracts transition information correctly (pptx.py:54-66): detects presence and identifies specific type (fade, cut, push, wipe, dissolve)
Metric logic is correct (pptx.py:23-34): when expected_transition_type is provided, counts only slides with matching type using case-insensitive comparison
Expected configuration is semantically correct: all_have_transitions=true and expected_transition_type='fade' match instruction requirements
Partial credit logic is appropriate: returns proportion of slides with correct transition type, ensuring agents cannot bypass requirements
Postconfig correctly saves file (Ctrl+S) before reading PPTX, ensuring getter reads updated state
